items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 4 at 8:11AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
A system moving through the area is bringing with it periods of
snow and rain to Isabel Pass. Warming weather during the morning
will see snow change over to rain during daytime hours. Cooling
conditions overnight will lead to refreezing of previous snow-melt
and rain on roadways, creating particularly slick and slippery
conditions.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 4 at 7:38AM AKDT until October 4 at 10:45AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
Heavy rain overnight into this morning has led to a rise in Montana
Creek. The creek is expected to crest this morning then fall back
below minor flood by this afternoon as rain rates lower.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Montana Creek near areas near the low water crossing on
Montana Creek Road and near Back Loop Road at the Montana Creek
bridge.

* WHEN...Until 1045 AM AKDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 4 at 6:40AM AKDT until October 4 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

accumulations of 2 to 4 inches. Light glaze ice accumulation
possible.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 4 at 5:32AM AKDT until October 4 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West to Southwest winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Unalaska and Nikolski.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result. Travel may be difficult.
